title: Identifiability and Order-Dimension Limits of In-Context Learning on Partial Orders
abstract: arXiv:2608.14004v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In-context learning is commonly formalized as inference from examples of a function. Partial orders instead combine transitivity, antisymmetry, and incomparability, so a finite prompt may not determine a queried comparison. We develop a theory of in-context learning on partial orders that separates logical identifiability, prompt teaching cost, structural complexity, and the exact capacity of a formal coordinate-decoder class. A version-space semantics makes background knowledge and open- versus closed-world assumptions explicit. For finite open-world prompts with positive and negative comparisons, we prove an exact completion trichotomy: after taking the reflexive transitive closure of the positive demonstrations, a query is forced true, forced false because every true completion creates a cycle or violates a negative demonstration, or remains genuinely ambiguous. For a known $n$-element universe, we characterize the open-world teaching

translated_title: 偏序集上上下文学习的可辨识性与序维极限
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14004v1 公告类型：新 摘要：上下文学习通常被形式化为从函数示例中进行推断。偏序集则结合了传递性、反对称性和不可比性，因此有限提示可能无法确定所查询的比较关系。我们发展了一种关于偏序集上上下文学习的理论，该理论将逻辑可辨识性、提示教学成本、结构复杂性以及形式坐标解码器类的精确容量分离开来。版本空间语义使背景知识以及开放世界与封闭世界假设变得明确。对于具有正负比较的有限开放世界提示，我们证明了一个精确的完备性三分法：在取正示例的自反传递闭包之后，一个查询要么被强制为真，要么因为每个真实完备化都会创建环或违反负示例而被强制为假，要么仍然真正模糊。对于已知的$n$元素宇宙，我们刻画了开放世界教学的特征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种偏序集上上下文学习的理论，通过版本空间语义区分逻辑可辨识性、教学成本和结构复杂度，并证明了有限开放世界提示下查询完备性的三分法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theory of in-context learning on partial orders, separating logical identifiability, teaching cost, and structural complexity, and proves a trichotomy of query completion for finite open-world prompts.
